note: BMX MOUNTAIN (https://wavedash.com/games/bmx-mountain) is capture-class: a custom Vite production build served by the Wavedash platform from a per-build CDN host (the platform page server-renders playKey/gameCloudId/gameBuild and the game runs in an iframe whose src carries the playKey + sdkconfig; see tools/update.mjs). §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — the page carries no link to a public source repo (platform SDK/library credits only; the bundle ships no LICENSE/source references of its own), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, applied to a VERIFIED FIXED POINT — ≤4 passes, stability checked at derive time; every file stabilizes in one pass except the main game bundle, which needs two; never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<served path>.pretty.js|css per captured JS/CSS file (the capture preserves the served URL structure — repo root == CDN host root — so the derived layers MIRROR it: real subdirectories and the served filenames (hash included) are kept, no __-flattening; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<served path>-NN.js of every APP chunk (top-level declaration boundaries only, ~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. The identifier rename campaign (PLAN §5) is applied to the app slices: the chunk's top-level bindings get semantic names (tools/names.json), written by tools/apply-names.mjs with a scope-aware token pass, recovered mechanically into rename-map.json (tools/recover-scoped-map.mjs: token alignment, non-identifier positions identical) and re-applied by tools/derive.mjs through that recorded map — `files` word-boundary records plus `scoped` token-index records; the chunk's fired bindings are recorded here as sources[].renameBindings. Vendor identifiers and public export names keep their served names. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range (through the recorded rename map where the chunk is renamed). Vendor rule — wholeFile sections, never sliced: embed.js (Wavedash platform embed SDK), sw-embed.js (embed service worker), the Vite modulepreload polyfill and the bundled three.js r186 region inside assets/index-gCVK5XnX.js (core + node/TSL + WebGPURenderer/WebGLRenderer), content-anchored and guarded. Boundary note: the app's first slice is the tail of a minifier-merged `var` declaration whose head closes the three.js region, so it starts mid-declaration (flagged `boundary`; still byte-exact and standalone-parsing). Machinery/non-standalone parts are skipped or wholeFile sections, indexed but never sliced. Stylesheet rule — embed.css is wholeFile. Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html carries one inline <style> block; `embed` (the dynamic platform shell, JWT-bearing) carries the inline window.__WAVEDASH_GAME__ boot script — twins + readable/index-inline-map.json (the `embed` bytes rotate per session: JWT/sessionToken, marked dynamic in the manifest). Binary payloads — tex/*.webp (24 textures) and sfx/*.wav (45 sounds) — are sha256-recorded notRendered: served byte-exact, never text-derived, never re-encoded. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
